_note: This is the game's DEFAULT style — used for room backgrounds and in-room character sprites (the actual walkable game). Cutscene-only portrait art (the prologue slides) intentionally bypasses this file and uses hand-written prompts instead — see the 'asset' text on those generation calls. Do not merge the two: a room needs a real overhead floor plane the player can walk on, a cutscene portrait needs a close-up face. Changed 2026-08-19 from a close-up cinematic-portrait camera after that framing was used for room backgrounds by mistake and looked like a photo backdrop with paper cutouts standing in front of it, not a room you walk around in.
camera: Top-down RPG room view: a raised 3/4 angled perspective looking down and slightly forward into the space (classic 16-bit console RPG overworld/interior framing — Chrono Trigger, Secret of Mana, Stardew Valley interiors). NEVER an eye-level photograph and NEVER a close-up character-portrait crop.
style: Detailed 16-bit-style top-down pixel art with painterly shading: visible chunky pixel blocks with soft gradients within them, warm dramatic lighting, moody atmospheric depth, confident dark outlines. For a ROOM: an unbroken floor plane fills the lower half to two-thirds of the frame with nothing sitting on it but furniture, and walls/shelving/furniture recede toward the back — the floor must read as clearly walkable open space. For a CHARACTER SPRITE: small full-body top-down proportions (slightly stylized, not a realistic close-up bust), head-to-feet, readable silhouette from the overhead angle described above.
palette: Saturated, warm-vs-cool contrast (amber/gold light against deep purple, indigo, or crimson shadow). Rooms run darker and more desaturated than any character sprite standing in them so characters pop.
background: For a ROOM: a full furnished top-down interior appropriate to the space, empty of any characters, with a clear open floor area. For a CHARACTER SPRITE: isolated on a transparent background, no scene/ground/shadow drawn in.
constraints: No text, no logos, no watermark, no UI elements, no borders/frames baked into the image. A character sprite must be full body head-to-feet, standing, facing toward the viewer — never a close-up bust/portrait crop.
